text:
Alex Chen: hey team — first day here! I'm trying to get into Redwood Console (staging) and the admin panels for feature flags/user admin but keep hitting 403 / SSO redirect loop. Who should I ping for access?

Samir Patel: welcome Alex :tada: Did you finish the Okta onboarding flow? Usually missing group membership causes that. Check for 'console-staging-users' and 'ff-admin'.

Alex Chen: I completed the onboarding form yesterday; Okta shows my status as "pending approval". Where does that get approved?

Samir Patel: approvals go through DevEx self-service. Open https://tools.redwood.com/access-requests -> select "Console: Staging", attach your HR/new-hire badge ID, and pick the groups: console-staging-users, ff-admin, console-admin.

Alex Chen: ok I'm on the page. Do I need to include anything else?

Samir Patel: if you'll need feature-ops access for flags, put that in the "notes" field. Also ensure you're connected to corp-vpn or allow the SSO redirect through split-tunnel.

Alex Chen: I'm on corp-vpn. I can curl the health endpoint but the UI 403s.

Alex Chen: ```curl -I https://console-staging.redwood.ai/health
HTTP/2 200```

Samir Patel: cool health is reachable so it's auth. Can you paste the access request ID after you submit? I'll add a note to fast-track.

Alex Chen: submitted — request ID AR-2026-1123

DevEx Bot: New access request created: AR-2026-1123. Assigned to devex-admins. ETA 1 business day.

Jules (Eng Manager): welcome to the team Alex! For feature flags we'll also need the 'feature-ops' tag on your account. Samir, can you add that in the approval?

Samir Patel: added a note to the request for 'feature-ops'. @ops-oncall can you fast-track approvals for a new hire?

ops-oncall: taking it now, will approve manually.

DevEx Bot: Access request AR-2026-1123 approved by ops-oncall. User Alex Chen added to groups: console-staging-users, ff-admin, console-admin, feature-ops.

Alex Chen: confirmed — I can log in and see the feature flags UI and the admin panels. Thanks everyone :100:

Samir Patel: 👍 welcome aboard! If you want a quick 10m walkthrough of the Console feature-flag flows DM me and I can demo common tasks (create flag, target rollout, audit logs).

Alex Chen: will do, thanks Samir and thanks all!
